title: CMHA-HP-FCC: Contact-Guided Multi-Block Heat-Bath Annealing
description: Reproducible classical CMHA solver for HP protein folding on the FCC lattice. Includes 31 primary benchmark profiles, 28 matched ablation profiles, four additional independent-seed runs, 1008 validated worker-best records, sampled proposal diagnostics and revised figure-generation tools. The tested solver and primary/ablation values are unchanged.
